description: Translate a grind setting from one coffee grinder to another. Use whenever a recipe quotes a setting for a grinder the user does not own — "the recipe says 18 clicks on a Comandante, what is that on my Encore?". Grinder names can be written however the user said them ("Fellow Ode", "1Zpresso J-Max"); exact slugs are not required.

from.description: The grinder the setting is quoted for, e.g. "Comandante C40 MK4"

setting.description: The setting on the source grinder as written on it, e.g. 18. On Fellow dials the digit after the point counts marks (4.2 on an Ode is the second mark after 4); a Baratza Forte is macro number and micro letter, e.g. "4R".

to.description: The grinder to convert to, e.g. "Baratza Encore"

name: convert_grind_setting
title: Convert a grind setting
